title: kleos
tagline: A social, on-chain prediction market where anyone spins up niche markets in seconds.

prizes.title: MAIN TRACK: use protocols on Flare blockchain

description: Spin up spicy, niche markets in seconds—USDC-collateralized tokens, constant liquidity, and a crisp Polymarket-style shares UI. Resolution is composable: snap in FTSO feeds, FDC-attested Web2 JSON, secure RNG, human multisig—or let agents/LLMs pitch outcomes (attested or not 😀). The hybrid oracle+agent flow keeps tiny markets lively, fast, and fair—winners cash out exactly 1 USDC per share.
how_its_made: Our platform uses a Market Factory to spin up clean, isolated smart contracts—one per question—so funds are escrowed per market and stakes remain fully auditable. Each market tracks user positions on YES/NO and settles via a modular resolver: for price or threshold questions it reads Flare’s FTSOv2 on-chain feeds at endTime for deterministic resolution, while for event or textual questions an AI module returns a strict JSON outcome with rationale, optionally gated by a Flare Data Connector attestation for verifiable source data. This separation of creation, custody, and resolution makes the system composable, transparent, and adaptable to the trust model each market demands.
